content: The DSD sub-module shall check the received diagnostic request in the order given by ISO14229-1 [1]. If one of the computations failed the Dcm shall stop the execution of the NRC check sequence then stop or do not start the execution of the received diagnostic request and finally transmit the NRC for which the computation failed.
